{{Quote|Damn it, Krupo! I told you how precious my babies are to me, and you go and crash the ship with them in it!|Yarvok, about his pets|<ref name="Codex" />}}
'''Wa-Vendeg''' was the name of a pet [[Skar'kla]] owned by [[Yarvok]], a [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]] of the [[Nova Blades]] [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] gang. Yarvok claimed to have brought up Wa-Vendeg himself, just like he did his other two Skar'kla, [[Rox (Skar'kla)|Rox]] and [[Yug]]. [[Krupo]], a beast wrangler, lost Wa-Vendeg along with many of Yarvok's other pets after a ship holding the pets crashed on [[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]], enraging [[Yarvok]]. Yarvok said he would [[Death/Legends|kill]] Krupo if his lost pets, including Wa-Vendeg, were not located and returned as soon as possible because Yarvok feared for their safety.<ref name="Codex" />

==Behind the scenes==
Wa-Vendeg was mentioned in the Codex entry for Invasive Species on Dantooine in the [[2019]] expansion [[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Onslaught|''Onslaught'']] to the [[2011]] [[Star Wars video games|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' by the company [[BioWare]].<ref name="Codex" />
